label: Staffing planner demo (Hire/Move/Upskill/Hybrid)

scenario.target_date_note: Target: a ready team in 42 days (six weeks).
scenario.allocation_note: Open requisition "Senior Backend Engineer" (Platform) with 2 scored applicant(s) in the pipeline.

options.label: Hire externally
options.source: Best applicant match in the current pipeline (66% engine score)
constraints: 56 days to ready — exceeds the 42-day window
Resume skills are claims until verified — a work sample and references are the evidence path
Cost/time are demo assumptions, not a quote
options.note: External search, notice period and onboarding take longer than the 42-day window — flagged as a constraint.

options.label: Move internally
constraints: Requires internal-mobility policy approval and the current manager's sign-off
The vacated role needs a backfill decision
Coverage is today's verified skills — any gap needs training
options.note: Internal move: manager approval, handover and focused retraining. Requires a backfill decision.

options.label: Upskill internally
options.source: Ingrid Ito (Platform) — 54% today → 98% after training Go + REST APIs
constraints: Trained skills are claims (verification_rigor: low) until a work sample or review confirms them
42-day window fits one focused training track, not a senior ramp
options.note: Focused training plus evidence verification. Trained skills are claims until verified — the planner says so, not the trainer.

options.label: Hybrid (hire + upskill)
options.source: Best applicant match in the current pipeline (66% engine score) · Ingrid Ito (Platform) — 54% today → 98% after training Go + REST APIs
constraints: Depends on both tracks executing — hiring AND the training track
External lead time still risks the window; internal track derisks it
options.note: Combined coverage assumes both tracks succeed. Planning estimate under demo assumptions.

planning_note: Coverage is computed deterministically from verified skills via the Skill Intelligence Graph. Cost/time are EXPLICIT demo assumptions — planning estimates, not guarantees, quotes, or promises of hiring quality.
